dimensions.assessment: Affects VA medical center schedulers, veterans receiving care through the Veterans Community Care Program, and participating external health care providers.
dimensions.evidence: assist the Department in scheduling appointments for care and services under the Veterans Community Care Program

dimensions.assessment: Aims to improve administrative scheduling efficiency and reduce wait times for medical appointments.
dimensions.evidence: reducing the time (measured in days) from referral date of veterans to health care providers... to the actual scheduling of appointments

dimensions.assessment: The source authorizes the procurement of technology systems through existing or new contracts but does not state specific dollar amounts.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may procure such systems as described in paragraph (1) through an existing contract entered into by the Department, if feasible, or a new contract.

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title 38 to mandate a specific national scheduling technology system and annual congressional reporting through 2028.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1703 of title 38, United States Code, is amended... by inserting after subsection (p) the following new subsection (q)

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent statutory program requirement alongside annual reporting mandates through September 30, 2028.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than September 30 of each year through 2028, the Secretary shall submit... a report on the progress

missing_information: Contract costs and total budget required for developing or procuring the scheduling technology systems
importance_detail.rationale: The bill requires the VA to develop or procure technology systems for real-time external provider scheduling under the Veterans Community Care Program with the intent of reducing wait times.
